title: Extension by zero of a finite constant sheaf along a qcqs etale map is constructible
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, $\Lambda_X$ the constant sheaf of rings with value $\Lambda$ on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $M$ a finite $\Lambda$-module (finite as a set), with $\underline M_X$ the constant sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules with value $M$ on $X_{\Et}$. Let $j:U\to X$ be an etale morphism with $U$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated, an object of $X_{\Et}$. Let $P_{U,M}$ be the presheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ given by $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\mathrm{Hom}_X(V,U)}\underline M_X(V)$, whose restriction along $\psi:V'\to V$ sends the summand of $\varphi$ to the summand of $\varphi\psi$ by the restriction map of $\underline M_X$ along $\psi$, and let $j_!\underline M_U=P_{U,M}^\#$ be its sheafification as a presheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], a sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (this is the extension by zero $v_!$ of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] applied to the constant sheaf $\underline M$ on $U_{\Et}$; for $M=\Lambda$ it is the sheafification of the presheaf $\Lambda_X[h_U]$ of [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module], the sheaf $j_{U!}\Lambda_U$ of [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-grothendieck-abelian]). Then $j_!\underline M_U$ is a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf].
